caption: The drawing depicts a single ornate andiron, featuring a predominantly gold-colored structure with detailed shading to emphasize its three-dimensional shape. The andiron has a tall, vertically oriented central column with a large, spherical element in the upper section, topped with a series of turned, spire-like finials. The central column tapers downward into a hexagonal base, from which three curved legs extend outward, each ending in a stylized paw-like foot with individual toes. Attached to the side of the column is a horizontal support arm that arches outward and ends in a flat, metallic prong designed to hold logs in place; this support arm is gray in color, contrasting with the gold of the rest of the andiron. The background is a plain, light beige tone, and the entire composition is enclosed within a thin rectangular border. The artist's name, "Hans Korsch," appears in the lower left corner within the border.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
